reason: The complete startup, ordinary sorted-inventory, TTY rendering, and #optionsfull boundary is implemented and source/fresh validated; the implementation commit identity is pending the readiness follow-up.

boundary.startingEvent: Startup parses OPTIONS=menu_objsyms or its use_menu_glyphs alias, then the player opens the ordinary inventory with i.
boundary.endingEvent: The inventory menu has rendered and been dismissed, and #optionsfull reports the effective menu_objsyms mode.
boundary.validInputs: Bare canonical and alias forms, negation, missing/empty values, numeric spellings, the six canonical mode names and source-permitted abbreviations, one-or-the-other, and invalid numeric or text values; ordinary sorted-pack inventory with one or more class headings.
boundary.observables: Configuration-error output, iflags.menuobjsyms/menu_head_objsym/use_menu_glyphs, header text and padding, entry glyph byte/color at TTY column 2, complete inventory screens and attributes, menu value, cursors, and unchanged PRNG order.
boundary.exclusions: Interactive handler_menu_objsyms(), !sortpack layout, partial or forced inventory menus, permanent inventory, non-TTY window ports, menu coloring, menuinvertmode, and behavior after the ordinary inventory/#optionsfull boundary.

candidateListMethod.upstreamEntryPoints: options.c optfn_menu_objsyms()/set_menuobjsyms_flags(), invent.c display_pickinv()/let_to_name(), and win/tty/wintty.c process_menu_window().
candidateListMethod.dispatchTablesAndCatalogs: The generated optlist.h row fixes the canonical name, alias, negation/value eligibility, and setwhere; options.c objsymvals[] exhaustively defines modes 0 through 5 and their names.
candidateListMethod.reachableHelpers: Traced do_init/do_set/get_val/do_handler, numeric/text/alias branches, coupled flag derivation, inventory class-heading insertion and obj_to_glyph/map_glyphinfo production, TTY whole-menu header scan, and the column-2 glyph/color overwrite.
candidateListMethod.javascriptCrossCheck: Searched js/options.js defaults/generic compound fallback/menu guard, js/invent.js let_to_name()/display_pickinv() stops and menu-item shape, js/tty_menu.js itemLine()/rendering, object glyph consumers, and focused parser/inventory/menu tests.
candidateListMethod.remainingLimits: The selected runtime is TTY with sortpack enabled and an ordinary full inventory. Modes 4 and 5 still require the source whole-menu scan even though !sortpack, where their entry behavior differs, is excluded.

entries.reachability: Every startup initialization invokes do_init before configuration parsing.
entries.effects: Initializes mode 4, menu_head_objsym false, and use_menu_glyphs true as one coupled state update.
entries.evidence: options.c optfn_menu_objsyms(do_init) calls set_menuobjsyms_flags(4); parseNethackrc() now invokes the same source-mapped helper and focused tests pin all three defaults.

entries.candidate: bare canonical, bare alias, negation, and empty-value forms
entries.reachability: The optlist row permits negation and a value; parseoptions alias matching can deliver either spelling to do_set with empty_optstr.
entries.effects: Bare menu_objsyms selects headers (1), bare use_menu_glyphs selects entries (2), either negation selects none (0), while an explicit empty value follows the source empty-opt behavior.
entries.evidence: options.c optfn_menu_objsyms do_set first two branches; focused tests pin canonical and alias case quirks, empty values, negation, and ignored negated parameters.

entries.reachability: A non-negated value whose first byte is a decimal digit enters atoi().
entries.effects: Selects the parsed integer mode and derives both companion flags.
entries.evidence: options.c optfn_menu_objsyms digit/atoi branch and six-entry objsymvals[]; focused tests pin modes 0 through 5 and numeric suffix consumption.

entries.candidate: numeric values at or above six
entries.reachability: A value beginning with a digit whose atoi result is at least SIZE(objsymvals) reaches the only handler diagnostic.
entries.effects: Adds Illegal menu_objsyms parameter, returns without changing the prior mode, and waits through config_error_done().
entries.evidence: options.c optfn_menu_objsyms numeric guard; focused and fresh error cases pin the exact diagnostic and preservation of a prior accepted mode.

entries.reachability: A nonnumeric value is compared case-insensitively against the six objsymvals names; canonical abbreviations need at least four bytes.
entries.effects: Selects the first matching mode; nonmatching text silently falls back to none (0).
entries.evidence: options.c optfn_menu_objsyms k/l prefix loop over objsymvals[]; focused tests pin all names, four-byte prefixes, case folding, suffix rejection, and fallback to none.

entries.reachability: The exact long alternate for mode 5 is checked only on the i==5 loop entry.
entries.effects: Selects one-or-other mode 5 without a diagnostic.
entries.evidence: options.c optfn_menu_objsyms alt5 branch; tests pin the exact alternate, its source-permitted suffix, and nonmatching short forms.

entries.reachability: Every accepted/default/negated do_set outcome calls the helper exactly once.
entries.effects: Stores mode; sets menu_head_objsym from bit 1 and use_menu_glyphs from bits 2 or 4, with no duplicate state elsewhere.
entries.evidence: options.c set_menuobjsyms_flags(); js/options.js now keeps all three fields in one helper and retains no raw flags.menu_objsyms value.

entries.reachability: The O/m menu invokes optfn_menu_objsyms(get_val) after startup configuration.
entries.effects: Reports the canonical objsymvals name for the effective numeric mode without refusing the menu.
entries.evidence: options.c get_val/get_cnf_val; menu_objsyms no longer needs the raw-text guard, and the fresh matrix reaches the canonical value for every effective mode.

entries.reachability: Ordinary i inventory with sortpack and want_reply inserts one heading for each present class; odd menuobjsyms modes request showsym.
entries.effects: Pads the class name toward eight columns and appends two spaces plus the quoted compiled-in default object-class symbol.
entries.evidence: invent.c let_to_name(); js/invent.js now reproduces the seven-byte padding target and def_oc_syms byte, with focused and inventory-screen tests.

entries.reachability: Every normal inventory object calls obj_to_glyph/map_glyphinfo before add_menu regardless of whether TTY later displays entry symbols.
entries.effects: Carries the object glyph byte and glyph color with each selectable entry while retaining selector, label, and value.
entries.evidence: invent.c display_pickinv normal-item arm; js/invent.js now computes obj_to_glyph before doname and carries the resolved byte/color to every ordinary entry.

entries.reachability: Modes 4 and 5 set bit 4; process_menu_window scans the complete linked menu before pagination and suppresses entry glyphs if any identifier-zero header exists.
entries.effects: Derives one show_obj_syms value for the whole menu, independent of the visible page.
entries.evidence: wintty.c process_menu_window only_if_no_headers loop; renderTtyMenu() scans the full spec before page rendering and a focused two-page case puts the decisive header on page two.

entries.candidate: TTY entry glyph overwrite and color
entries.reachability: A selectable entry with a real glyph reaches draw-loop byte offset 2 when use_menu_glyphs is effective and the entry is not selected.
entries.effects: Replaces the '-' marker with glyph ttychar at byte column 2 using glyph color for that cell, then restores line styling.
entries.evidence: wintty.c process_menu_window draw loop; renderTtyMenu() overwrites byte column two with glyph color and focused tests pin selected-marker precedence.

entries.reachability: Each effective mode 0 through 5 can be configured before the same ordinary i inventory.
entries.owner: js/options.js, js/invent.js, and js/tty_menu.js integrated path
entries.effects: Produces the source combination of header symbols and entry glyphs, then dismisses with matching screen, cursor, and PRNG sequence.
entries.evidence: The final seed 921337 ten-segment matrix matched 27,490 PRNG calls and 141 complete screens/cursors through inventory dismissal and #optionsfull across all six modes and parser families.

entries.reachability: Requires do_handler from an in-game option application rather than startup parsing or menu value display.
entries.effects: First state mutation occurs after this slice's ending boundary.
entries.evidence: options.c optfn_menu_objsyms(do_handler) calls handler_menu_objsyms(); selected scope excludes interactive application.

entries.reachability: Each requires a configuration or caller/window mode excluded from the ordinary sorted TTY inventory boundary.
entries.effects: Their first distinct layout or rendering effect occurs outside this slice.
entries.evidence: invent.c display_pickinv branch structure and window-port dispatch; JavaScript already has named stops for partial/forced/reordered inventory.
entries.remaining: Retain existing named boundaries for their own slices.

sourceReview: Source-derived implementation now covers all thirteen reachable candidates from optfn_menu_objsyms()/set_menuobjsyms_flags() through let_to_name()/display_pickinv(), TTY process_menu_window(), inventory dismissal, and #optionsfull. The final ten-segment seed 921337 comparison matched 27,490 PRNG calls and 141 complete screens/cursors with zero animation frames. It also settled the case-sensitive bare-alias quirk and the alternate mode-5 suffix behavior directly from source. Interactive application and alternate inventory/window modes remain later as declared.
